build.build_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
cd /home/nihalp/prod/cuda-rust/cuda-oxide
export CUDA_OXIDE_BACKEND=/tmp/primitives-api-evidence/tools/backend/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/debug/librustc_codegen_cuda.so
export CUDA_OXIDE_CUTLASS_COMPILER=/home/nihalp/.cargo/cuda-oxide/toolchains/cutlass/4.7.0/x86_64-cu13/lib/libCutlassCompiler.so
export CUDA_OXIDE_DEVICE_BACKEND=cutlass-mlir
export CUDA_OXIDE_MLIR_PROFILE=cutlass-full-cute-mlir22
export CUDA_OXIDE_DUMP_MIR=1 CUDA_OXIDE_VERBOSE=1
export CUDA_OXIDE_PTX_DIR=/tmp/fmha-decode-compiler-regression
export CUDA_OXIDE_MLIR_OUTPUT=/tmp/fmha-decode-compiler-regression/fmha.mlir
mkdir -p /tmp/fmha-decode-compiler-regression
/tmp/primitives-api-evidence/tools/cli/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/debug/cargo-oxide build --arch sm_120a --cargo-target-dir /tmp/fmha-decode-compiler-regression/target --device-codegen-crate fmha_decode_sm120a_cute -- --manifest-path cute-rs-preview/examples/fmha_decode_sm120a_cute/Cargo.toml --release --offline > /tmp/fmha-decode-compiler-regression/build.log 2>&1 || { tail -65 /tmp/fmha-decode-compiler-regression/build.log; exit 1; }
tail -8 /tmp/fmha-decode-compiler-regression/build.log
